buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Terms & Conditions for Submitting Sample Paper i. The Braille Paper quoted reels supplied must have a width of 30.5 cm. ii. The Braille Paper quoted should be of 140 GSM. iii. The Braille Paper quoted should be acid-free and lead-free. iv. The Braille Paper quoted must be made in India. v. A sample of 20 metres must be sent before the closing date of the technical bid to: Regional Director,

National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Regional Centre, Poonamallee, Chennai, Tamil Nadu – 600 056. vi. Every metre of the submitted sample must bear the seal and signature of the firm. vii. The submitted sample must be in-line with the technical specifications of the bid. viii. Samples sent should have super-scription in the cover as “Sample for Braille paper tender”. B. Bids are to be submitted for a total of 15 tonnes of “Braille Paper”. C. Braille Paper is to be supplied strictly in white colour only, as specified in the technical specification document. D. Bids submitted without samples, or with samples that do not fulfill the aforementioned conditions, shall be summarily rejected. E. The supplier should be ready to execute delivery of the contract order in partial lots, if requested by the buyer. F. A hard copy of the financial instrument substantiating the Earnest Money Deposit of ₹ 33,000/- must be mandatorily submitted to the address below within 5 days of the bid end/opening date, superscribed on th e cover as “Bid for Braille papers”: Regional Director, National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Regional Centre, Poonamallee, Chennai, Tamil Nadu – 600 056. G. The HSN code must be specified as 48239011 in both the technical bid submitted and the tax invoice g enerated through the GeM portal. H. GST rates must strictly comply with prevailing statutory GST norms (5%). .
